description: Work that failed and waits for the retry cron. Generic across integrations. A row exists only while its delta is non-empty and is deleted when the delta empties. Holds IDs only: no titles, bodies or payloads.

fields.description: Also the row's name. github:issue:REPOSITORY_ID:ISSUE_ID runs GitHub to Envision; github:task:TASK_NAME runs Envision to GitHub.
fields.label: Job Key

fields.description: The function the cron calls. Must be in the retry_job_handlers hook.
fields.label: Handler

fields.description: The IDs the handler needs, and nothing else.
fields.label: Target

fields.description: The work left to do, as {resource: action}.
fields.label: Delta

fields.description: Which integration owns the row. Selects its on-done hook, retry_job_on_done.
fields.label: Integration

fields.description: Empty for an Issue not imported yet, and once the referenced record is deleted.
fields.label: Reference Name

fields.description: Only for backoff and alerting, never a limit.
fields.label: Attempts

fields.description: The lease: a Running row older than the job timeout goes back to Pending.
fields.label: Started At

name: Envision Retry Job
